summary: Frontend E2E (Playwright) of Next.js 16 business card at preview URL, desktop 1536x800 + mobile 390x844. All requested features work: hero (name/title/portrait/thought bubble/website pill), partner cycling + hover pause, action dock (vcf download + Saved state, wa.me/tel/mailto hrefs), meeting scheduler (confirm disabled until slot, slot highlight, outside-click close), 6 service cards, 2 office cards with phone/map links, contact form validation + success + send-another reset, Mongo persistence visible in /inbox?key=..., /inbox locked without key or with wrong key. No page errors. Found 2 real UX bugs: form inputs are wiped after a validation error, and the mobile website pill is clipped off-screen.

ui_bugs.issue: After a failed validation submit, ALL typed fields are cleared (React 19 <form action> auto-resets uncontrolled inputs). Repro: mobile, fill name 'A', email 'bad@', message 'short', submit -> errors shown but inputs empty. User loses a long message if e.g. email is mistyped. Fix: return submitted values in ContactState and set defaultValue on inputs (keyed on state), or use controlled inputs / onSubmit with startTransition.

website-link pill is clipped off right edge: bounding box x=319,w=105 (ends at 424px > 390 viewport); hidden by hero overflow-hidden so arrow icon is invisible. RCA: hero-title is whitespace-nowrap (279px) and pill is shrink-0, so header content exceeds 366px available. Fix: allow title to wrap / truncate on mobile (e.g. whitespace-normal sm:whitespace-nowrap) or shrink tracking.

issues: Uses native browser <input type=date> picker instead of a shadcn Calendar component - inconsistent look
today computed via new Date().toISOString() (UTC) - for South Africa (UTC+2) between 00:00-02:00 the min date is yesterday; use local date
Inactive logos at opacity-40 + grayscale are nearly invisible for light logos (Ecodepur, Pioneer, Franklin Electric, Jesco) - consider opacity ~60
'Authorised distributor for' label slightly overlaps bottom of portrait image

action_items: Preserve contact form field values after validation errors (return values from server action and use defaultValue)
Fix mobile header so website pill is fully visible at 390px (let hero-title wrap on mobile)
Optional: replace native date input with shadcn Calendar; compute local today; raise inactive partner logo opacity
